summary: Added and passed an in-process API lifecycle regression test covering create, list, edit/status movement, delete, and invalid-status handling.

messages.content: QA found a minor UX gap: edit-form submission closes the dialog even when the PATCH request fails because mutate() catches errors internally. Keeping it open on failed saves would let users retry immediately.

decisions: Used an in-process handler harness so API tests exercise the real handler and SQLite logic without opening a network socket.
Verified Python compilation, frontend JavaScript syntax, and whitespace checks in addition to the lifecycle test.
